sprint_goal: Deliver the first version of an event-driven RESTful payment API with async processing, refund workflows, and PCI-compliant logging integrated with Stripe, Sift, Kafka, Redis, and PostgreSQL.

tasks.title: Set up FastAPI project structure and base configurations
tasks.description: Create the FastAPI application skeleton with project folder structure, environment configurations, and initial dependencies for async operations.

tasks.title: Design OpenAPI 3.0 specification for payment endpoints
tasks.description: Define OpenAPI schema for all payment-related endpoints including POST /payments, GET /payments/{id}, POST /payments/{id}/refund, GET /payments, and POST /payments/{id}/retry.

tasks.title: Implement POST /payments endpoint with idempotency check
tasks.description: Develop the endpoint to create payments, validate request payloads, store records in PostgreSQL, check Redis for idempotency, and publish event to Kafka for async processing.

tasks.title: Implement async payment processor and Stripe integration
tasks.description: Create background worker to handle Kafka events for payment creation, trigger Stripe charge operations asynchronously, and handle success/failure updates.

tasks.title: Implement GET /payments/{id} and GET /payments listing endpoints
tasks.description: Provide endpoints for retrieving payment details by ID and listing payments filtered by status and date range with pagination and validation errors using RFC 7807.

tasks.title: Implement POST /payments/{id}/refund endpoint and reconciliation trigger
tasks.description: Create refund endpoint supporting full and partial refunds, publish refund events to Kafka, and trigger automatic reconciliation job for completed payments.

tasks.title: Add POST /payments/{id}/retry endpoint and workflow logic
tasks.description: Develop retry mechanism for failed payments, ensure gateway idempotency during retrial, and log all retry actions for audit.

tasks.title: Implement PCI-DSS audit logging and rate limiting system
tasks.description: Add middleware for logging payment actions with masked PCI fields and enforce 100 requests/minute per API key using Redis-based rate limiting.

tasks.title: Create automated tests for payment and refund endpoints
tasks.description: Write pytest-based unit and integration tests covering payment creation, refunds, retry scenarios, and OpenAPI validation using async calls.

risks.description: Async Kafka processing may delay status updates or cause inconsistency in payment states.
risks.mitigation: Implement robust retry logic and monitoring for Kafka consumer offsets and reconciliation job.

risks.description: Stripe API rate limits could block high volume payment operations.
risks.mitigation: Introduce exponential backoff and centralized gateway retry management.

risks.description: PCI-DSS logging with unmasked sensitive data may breach compliance rules.
risks.mitigation: Ensure all payment logs are field-masked and review audit mechanisms with compliance officer.

risks.description: Redis rate limiting could impact API performance under heavy load.
risks.mitigation: Optimize Redis operations, implement cache expiry strategy, and introduce circuit breaker pattern.

definition_of_done: All endpoints return validated OpenAPI 3.0 responses.
Kafka and Stripe integrations tested with sandbox environment.
PCI-DSS audit logging verified with masked data.
Full unit and integration test coverage (>80%).
All API responses use RFC 7807 error format.
Code reviewed, merged, and deployed in staging environment.
